advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Gate the prerequisite_verify step (and/or short-circuit the verify call) so no LLM call is made when there are no focused findings.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml:141: - id: prerequisite_verify (no `when:` present; general verify is gated inside verify_branch)
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/prerequisite_workflow_ops.py: 'if not instructions: instructions = ["No focused findings; return an empty verifications array."]'
The general verify step is branch-gated (verify_branch) whereas prerequisite_verify is an ungated sibling
advisory.finding: The `prerequisite_verify` prompt step runs unconditionally (no `when:` guard) on every plan review, so it issues an LLM call even when there are no prerequisites or no prerequisite findings — in which case prerequisite_verify_inputs returns the placeholder ['No focused findings; return an empty verifications array.'] and the model is still called.
scenarios: Any plan-review run for a ticket with no direct prerequisites, or with prerequisites but no findings
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a `when` condition (e.g. on has_prerequisites and non-empty prerequisite_findings) to prerequisite_verify, or have the step skip the model call when instructions is only the placeholder.

src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:732:         if "prerequisite-consistency" in set(criteria or []):

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Order finalize_verdict so a genuine BLOCK (esp. retained DET blocks) wins over prerequisite_indeterminate, matching the DET-block-beats-llm_unavailable precedent.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:528: if coverage.get("prerequisite_indeterminate"):
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:530:     elif blocking:

workflow_ops decide retains DET blocks: 'retained_det = [f for f in parts["blocking"] if f.get("tier") == "DET"]' then 'parts["blocking"] = retained_det' (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:656-658)
The pre-existing ordering places blocking above llm_unavailable specifically so 'A DET block is still an actionable BLOCK even with no LLM' (orchestrator.py:524)
dropped.finding: finalize_verdict evaluates `coverage.get('prerequisite_indeterminate')` before the `blocking` branch, so any indeterminate prerequisite record downgrades the verdict to INDETERMINATE even when there is a genuine BLOCK finding — including DET blocks that plan_review_decide deliberately retains in parts['blocking'] (retained_det). A hard block can thus be masked by an unrelated prerequisite-coverage failure.
scenarios: A plan with a DET-blocking finding and a prerequisite whose coverage is attribution-invalid/output-invalid/input-too-large
dropped.suggested_fix: Move the `if blocking:` check above the `prerequisite_indeterminate` check (or only apply prerequisite_indeterminate when `not blocking`).
